claim_boundary: C008 adds five theta-inversion descendants rooted in existing JANUS hypotheses. None is proved or certified novel.

hypotheses.title: Certified Lovasz-Theta Gap SAT Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants c,k and a deterministic polynomial-time compiler that maps every CNF F of length N to a graph G_F and integer target M_F such that F is satisfiable iff alpha(G_F)=M_F, while every unsatisfiable F satisfies vartheta(G_F) <= M_F-1/N^c; the compiler also outputs polynomial-bit rational primal and dual SDP data whose gap certificate is independently checkable in N^k time.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Computing and certifying the Lovasz-theta gap would decide CNF-SAT in deterministic polynomial time and imply P = NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: turn the first theta relaxation into a complete two-sided SAT decision procedure with a certified inverse-polynomial gap.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix one standard SAT-to-independent-set reduction, define the exact rational SDP encoding, and test whether known random-3CNF theta failures already contradict the promised gap.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H070 replaces broad quotient, SoS, and counting promises by one concrete graph SDP, an explicit numerical gap, and a dual certificate requirement.
falsification_conditions: An explicit infinite unsatisfiable CNF family for which every permitted compiled graph has vartheta(G_F)=M_F or gap smaller than every inverse polynomial.
A proof that polynomial-bit dual certificates cannot certify the required gap for the compiler's outputs.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The ordinary Lovasz theta number is known to fail on important random 3CNF regimes; H070 survives only because it permits a new certified compiler rather than the generic reduction.

hypotheses.title: Finite-Lift Theta-Rank Obstruction Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible CNF family F_n such that every polynomial-size finite local constant-scope extension grammar of the type allowed by H045 produces a lifted ideal whose theta rank is n^Omega(1), even after polynomially many auxiliary variables with polynomial-bit coefficients.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Every constant-level exact SoS lift grammar covered by H045 would fail on F_n, destroying that proposed P = NP route and yielding an explicit hierarchy lower bound.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: convert the local SoS mechanism H045 into a theta-rank lower-bound target stable under permitted auxiliary variables.
hypotheses.next_gate: Choose a stable-set or CSP encoding with known SDP hardness and prove that the relevant theta-rank measure survives every allowed constant-scope extension gadget.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H071 specializes the common communication attack H051 to a concrete theta-rank invariant and imports H062's stability requirement for local transformations.
falsification_conditions: A finite local grammar satisfying H045 on the selected family with uniformly bounded theta rank.
A polynomial-size extension construction that collapses the selected family's theta rank to a constant.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known SDP lower bounds do not automatically survive arbitrary auxiliary-variable lifts; that preservation is the unproved core of H071.

hypotheses.title: Affine-Stable Theta-Rank Residual Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is an explicit mixed XOR and non-affine CNF family F_n such that after every polynomial-size sequence of certified Gaussian eliminations, invertible affine substitutions, and local cardinality definitions allowed by H042 and H062, the residual ideal has theta rank n^Omega(1) or the transformed representation has superpolynomial size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The same explicit family would obstruct affine-cardinality compilation, supply a quantitative invariant for H062, and create a candidate lower-bound family for parity-aware proof systems.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: use theta rank as the invariant that survives removal of all visible affine structure.
hypotheses.next_gate: Construct a deterministic mixed family and prove rank monotonicity or a controlled degradation theorem under each allowed affine operation.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H072 replaces the qualitative phrase 'wide non-affine residual' by a numerical theta-rank lower bound intended to persist under the exact affine operations of its parents.
falsification_conditions: A permitted affine compilation reducing the chosen family to bounded theta rank with polynomial size.
A counterexample showing theta rank can collapse arbitrarily under one allowed operation without corresponding representation growth.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No general affine-stability theorem for theta rank is claimed; establishing or refuting that theorem is the central task.

hypotheses.title: Theta-Certificate to Proof-System Transfer Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For Boolean polynomial systems from the JANUS SAT encodings, every level-k theta-body infeasibility certificate with rational data of bit length L can be translated uniformly into a proof in a fixed explicitly named SoS or Lovasz-Schrijver proof system of size poly(N,L,binomial(N,k)), and conversely every proof in that fragment yields a comparably sized theta certificate.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Theta-rank and certificate-size lower bounds could be transferred rigorously into proof-complexity lower bounds, while upper bounds would become independently checkable proof artifacts.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: make theta computations usable inside the existing proof graph without informal identification of SDP relaxations and proof systems.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the Boolean ideal, normalization, proof syntax, coefficient domain, and size measure, then formalize both translations for level one before general k.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H073 supplies the missing size- and bit-sensitive equivalence needed to turn H071's geometric rank claim into a proof-complexity statement.
falsification_conditions: A theta certificate family whose smallest corresponding proof is superpolynomially larger under the fixed measures.
A proof family whose semantic SDP certificate requires irrational or superpolynomial-bit data contrary to the statement.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Conceptual relationships between theta bodies, Lasserre, and SoS are known; H073 demands an exact uniform polynomial translation for the repository's encodings and accounting conventions.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Theta Inversion Indistinguishability Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every constant k and every fixed polynomial-time local preprocessing grammar selected from the C008 inversion matrix, there exist explicit satisfiable and unsatisfiable CNF families of polynomial size whose resulting level-k theta profiles agree on feasibility value, all registered low-degree moments, and every polynomial-bit dual statistic exposed by the grammar.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: No bounded-level theta-profile algorithm combined with the selected local preprocessing class can decide SAT universally; this would kill H070 for bounded levels and constrain H045-style mechanisms.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: construct front-side/back-side twin instances that bounded theta information cannot distinguish.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define canonical theta profiles and synthesize the first small SAT/UNSAT twins under the generic graph reduction before proving an explicit infinite family.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H074 turns the theta gap and rank questions into an adversarial twin-construction program, inheriting H060's certificate discipline for any claimed distinguishing statistic.
falsification_conditions: A fixed level k and permitted preprocessing grammar that separates every SAT instance from every UNSAT instance with a certified gap.
A theorem proving the requested complete profile equality impossible for all explicit opposite-label pairs.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Finite computational twins would only falsify particular invariants; an infinite explicit family is required for the universal claim.
